newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates plunge on inflow of funds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates plunge on inflow of funds.

text.p: Pakistani money rates dived on Thursday on a net inflow of six billion rupees and were seen staying low as the market closed in surplus, dealers said .
Overnight funds opened at 17 percent and heavy trading then took place at 10 percent to 13 percent, a dealer at KASB & Co said.
He said rates had plunged as low as four percent by the end of trading and some banks were left with surplus liquidity.
